subject.title: feat: add runtime self context config and tool

question: After the accelerator rendering defect is fixed, should OpenClaw adopt this top-level `runtimeContext` config and five-action `runtime` tool as the v1 core contract?
rationale: The code repair is mechanical, but correctness alone cannot decide the permanent core/plugin boundary or the upgrade commitment created by these public config, tool, and session-context surfaces.

options.title: Narrow the v1 contract
options.body: Ship current-runtime introspection first and defer action, offload, and cost fields until real provider integrations exercise them.

options.title: Approve the full v1 contract
options.body: Accept the complete schema and five-action tool as stable core API after the defect is fixed.

options.title: Pause for unified architecture
options.body: Review runtime context with execution placement and existing environments APIs before landing either contract.

recommendation.title: Narrow the v1 contract
recommendation.body: Ship current-runtime introspection first and defer action, offload, and cost fields until real provider integrations exercise them.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner to the central tool-catalog, config, environment, and hidden runtime-context surfaces needed to decide the core boundary.
